space.title: 🎷 하이 피델리티 재즈 카페 프리비즈
space.ambient: Gentle ambient life: candle flames flicker, the vinyl on the turntables spins slowly and dust motes drift in the golden sunbeams
space.continuity: the walls, storefront windows, glass door, green record shelves, listening bar, turntables, record bins, sofa, chairs, posters, plants, the two leads' outfits and the golden-hour light

shotMeta.subject: the two leads seen from behind just inside the glass door, with the warm record cafe beyond them
shotMeta.action: Seen from behind, the couple pauses just inside the doorway and takes in the room, the woman turning her head slightly toward the man. Golden afternoon light spills from the shop onto the autumn street; nothing else moves.

shotMeta.subject: the green record wall, framed jazz posters and the walnut listening bar, seen through the leads' eyes
shotMeta.action: Point-of-view look-around: the camera drifts forward and turns left across the glowing record shelves, black-and-white jazz posters and turntables, as if seen through the leads' eyes. Candle flames flicker and the records on the turntables spin slowly.

shotMeta.subject: the couple choosing records at the wooden record bin
shotMeta.action: The woman flips through the LPs in the bin with both hands while the man lifts one record sleeve to study its cover; they share a soft smile. The records in the foreground bin stay still.

shotMeta.subject: a natural wipe past the tall green record shelf divider, revealing the lounge
shotMeta.action: Transition: the camera trucks right past the tall green record shelf divider, which briefly fills the whole frame like a natural wipe, then glides toward the sunlit lounge where the couple now sits together on the cognac leather sofa.

shotMeta.subject: the couple sitting on the cognac leather sofa, listening to music with headphones
shotMeta.action: Wearing headphones, the woman rests her head on the man's shoulder with her eyes half closed and one hand on her ear cup, while the man sits calmly beside her. Sunbeams drift over them, the tube amplifier glows and the turntable keeps spinning.

scene.desc: A cozy vintage jazz record cafe called HIGH FIDELITY on a quiet autumn street in the late afternoon. Cream plaster walls and a polished pale stone floor with Persian rugs. The whole left wall is a built-in olive-green shelving unit packed with jazz vinyl, many sleeves displayed face-out, lit by warm LED strips under every shelf, with framed black-and-white jazz musician posters (a MILES DAVIS trumpet poster) between the units. In front of it runs a curved walnut listening bar with two turntables, a glowing vacuum-tube amplifier, walnut bookshelf speakers, brass mushroom lamps and candles, with olive velvet chrome bar stools. Wooden record bins full of LPs stand in the middle, with a tall green record-shelf divider beside them. At the back right is a lounge: a channel-tufted cognac leather sofa with green velvet cushions, a low walnut audio cabinet with a tube amp and turntable, floor-standing walnut speakers, a dark marble cafe table with a candle, a cream boucle lounge chair, framed photos and a large fiddle-leaf fig. Big storefront windows with gold lettering 'HIGH FIDELITY JAZZ CAFE' look onto golden autumn trees and street lamps. The two leads: a tall young man with tousled silver-white hair in a long dark-brown herringbone wool coat, black turtleneck, long brown plaid scarf, brown trousers and brown leather shoes; and a young woman with very long wavy auburn-brown hair in a beige knit cardigan with gold buttons, a cream blouse with a big bow, a long brown plaid A-line skirt, tall brown leather boots and a small brown leather shoulder bag.
scene.style: Warm golden-hour cinematic romance look in a polished semi-realistic anime-illustration style. Low amber sunlight streams through the windows in long beams across the floor, warm 2700K candle and lamp glow, olive green, walnut, cognac and cream palette, soft bloom and sparkling bokeh, shallow depth of field with the leads sharp. Consistent faces, hair, outfits and lighting in every shot.
scene.avoid: No extra customers or staff, no costume, hair color or face changes between shots, no layout or furniture changes, no objects teleporting, no warped hands or faces, no extra text, logos or subtitles beyond the window lettering and the MILES DAVIS poster.
